q: How much did I spend in total this month?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{month_start}'

q: How much did I spend last month?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date BETWEEN '{last_month_start}' AND '{last_month_end}'

q: How much did I spend on coffee this year?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE subcategory = 'coffee' AND txn_date >= '{year_start}'

q: How much did I spend on coffee in the last three months?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE subcategory = 'coffee' AND txn_date >= '{three_months_ago}'

q: How many times did I buy coffee this year?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM v_expenses WHERE subcategory = 'coffee' AND txn_date >= '{year_start}'

q: What are my top 5 spending categories this year?
sql: SELECT category, sum(amount) t FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{year_start}' GROUP BY category ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 5

q: Spend per month over the last six months
sql: SELECT month, sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{six_months_ago}' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

q: What was my single biggest expense this year?
sql: SELECT max(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{year_start}'

q: Which merchant did I spend the most at in the last 12 months?
sql: SELECT merchant FROM v_expenses WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL AND txn_date >= '{twelve_months_ago}' GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY sum(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How much did I spend on food last month?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE category = 'Food' AND txn_date BETWEEN '{last_month_start}' AND '{last_month_end}'

q: What is my average monthly spend over the last six months?
sql: SELECT avg(t) FROM (SELECT sum(amount) t FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{six_months_ago}' GROUP BY month)

q: How much income did I receive this year?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_entries WHERE kind = 'income' AND txn_date >= '{year_start}'

q: How much did I put into investments this year?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_entries WHERE kind = 'transfer' AND category = 'Investments' AND txn_date >= '{year_start}'

q: How much did I spend in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{days_30_ago}'

q: How many expense entries do I have in total?
What did I spend on each subcategory of food this year?
sql: SELECT subcategory, sum(amount) t FROM v_expenses WHERE category = 'Food' AND txn_date >= '{year_start}' GROUP BY subcategory ORDER BY t DESC

q: Which month had my highest spending in the last twelve months?
sql: SELECT month FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{twelve_months_ago}' GROUP BY month ORDER BY sum(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How much did I spend on weekends this year?
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date >= '{year_start}' AND strftime('%w', txn_date) IN ('0','6')

q: What was my total spend today?
sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) FROM v_expenses WHERE txn_date = '{today}'
